h1: Two-step login for accounts that need extra safety
overview: A password alone is not always enough, especially for admins and paying customers. We add a second step at login, where the user enters a short code from an authenticator app. We build the set-up screen with a QR code, backup codes for lost phones and a recovery path that does not leave people locked out. You choose who must use it, everyone or just some roles.

faq: What if a user loses their phone?
They can use a backup code, or contact support for a careful reset. We design the recovery so it is safe, and does not let a stranger talk their way in.
Does it work with Google Authenticator?
Yes. We use the standard time-based codes, so Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password and similar apps all work.
Will text message codes be included?
Not by default. Text codes are weaker and need a paid SMS service. Authenticator apps are safer. If you still need text, we can quote it separately.
Can I add it to an app that uses a login service?
Often yes. Auth0, Clerk, Firebase and others include two-step options. We turn those on if they fit, and build it ourselves only when it makes sense for you.
